description: This file defines the function 'pinmux_set' which configures pin multiplexing settings for specific hardware registers on an ARM1136-based platform, particularly within the context of U-Boot bootloader code for the NAS782x platform.

methods.name: void pinmux_set(int bank,int pin,int func)
methods.description: Sets the pin multiplexing configuration for a specified bank and pin to a specified function. It manipulates hardware registers based on parameters.
